headline: Executive session to interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to consider or interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position. The Chair will announce whether the open session will reconvene after executive session.
items: Executive session to consider or interview applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position

location: Fogg Room, Beverly Public Library, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915

# BEVERLY CITY COUNCIL
# BUDGET/MANAGEMENT ANALYST PRELIMINARY SCREENING COMMITTEE

Tuesday, October 6, 2026, 6:00 P.M.
Beverly Public Library
Fogg Room
32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915

## AGENDA

A. Regular/Open Session

B. Call to Order

C. Proposed Executive Session pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8), to consider or interview applicants for employment by a preliminary screening committee, if the Chair declares that an open meeting will have a detrimental effect in obtaining qualified applicants. Executive Session will be used for interviews and potentially to identify finalists for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.

D. Announcement by the Chair whether the Open Session will reconvene following Executive Session.

Received and Recorded, City Clerks Office: 2026 SEP 29 A 9:05
